headline_original: US activity and new business intakes rise at fastest rates since end of 2024
headline_cs: Aktivita a nové zakázky v amerických službách rostou nejrychleji od konce roku 2024
summary_cs: Finální průzkum S&P Global ukázal zrychlení aktivity a nových zakázek ve službách, přičemž růst nového byznysu byl nejrychlejší od prosince 2024. Inflační tlaky oproti červenci polevily, ale zůstaly nad dlouhodobým průměrem, takže zpráva je pro akcie růstově pozitivní, ale pro sazby není jednoznačně holubičí.

market_context_at_prediction.notes: The pre-prediction tape favored risk assets through lower yields, weaker DXY and low VIX, while expensive oil remained an inflation risk. The subsequent ISM Services release is stronger and more inflationary, so this S&P Global signal is treated as mixed rather than mechanically bullish.

predictions.mechanism: Stronger services growth supports earnings expectations, while still-elevated price pressures and the fresh ISM report keep rate risk alive.
predictions.invalidation: Treasury yields move decisively lower with benign inflation repricing, turning the growth signal clearly bullish, or yields surge enough to make the rate effect dominant bearish.

predictions.mechanism: Better demand is positive for growth but rate-sensitive technology remains vulnerable if strong services activity keeps yields elevated.
predictions.invalidation: A decisive post-data yield move resolves the current growth-versus-rates tension in either direction.

predictions.mechanism: Broader cyclical and value exposure can benefit more directly from resilient services demand than duration-heavy growth stocks.
predictions.invalidation: A sharp yield/inflation repricing overwhelms the growth benefit or risk sentiment deteriorates materially.
